counting_rule: Count every fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures, exceptions, and late results; no retry, resume, replacement candidate, or historical balance transfer.

hard_roster_limit.counting_rule: Union of selected_low_star_operator_ids and all DEPLOY action operator_id values; retreat and redeploy count each ID once.

non_stackable: M58 is closed at CLI 1/1 and simulation 0/1. Its unused simulation and all historical balances are not transferred.
objective_rule: Validate the frozen 30-action M58 A_SPOT_FUSION plan unchanged with at most one fixed full-stage simulation; complete WIN freezes immediately.
